summary: Focused re-test of iteration_4 HIGH bug (AnimatedCounter never reaching target) and Contact 'LOCATIONS' casing fix. Both fixes verified. All requested regressions pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home stats testids: home-stat-value-0..3 -> ['26','8','28','6']. About stats testids: about-stat-value-0..3 -> ['26','8','28','6']. Services page uses service-pillar-0..5 (6 pillars). Home service cards use home-service-card-* (6). Insights API returns 10 items. Contact renders 'LOCATIONS' (uppercase) in KO and EN, and shows 시카고 (Chicago). No 'CHAPTER —' text anywhere. No 'NJ'/'New Jersey' anywhere.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously AnimatedCounter useEffect depended on non-primitive parsed array that was re-created every render, restarting the RAF loop with a fresh startTime; the visible value reset to initial each frame yielding early values (13/4/7/3). Fix memoized parsed via useMemo(raw) and depended on primitive parsed+inView+duration, plus onComplete to lock final value. Verified counters now converge to 26/8/28/6.
